company.introduction: AstraZeneca researches, develops and sells prescription medicines to healthcare systems around the world. Its portfolio spans cancer treatments, cardiovascular and kidney disease, respiratory and immune conditions, and rare diseases, with products including Tagrisso, Farxiga and medicines from its Alexion business. Sales of approved treatments fund research into new medicines and additional uses for existing products. The company combines laboratory research, clinical trials, regulatory work and large-scale pharmaceutical manufacturing. Its business depends on demonstrating clinical benefits, securing reimbursement and maintaining reliable supply, while patent expiry and competing treatments continually change the commercial prospects of individual medicines.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
